_note: Art Gallery content. Only Victoria's own supplied files go here: never generated or stand-in artwork. To hang a piece: put the file in assets/art/, set image, title, year, medium, alt, story, frame (portrait, landscape or oval) and placeholder false. 'position' (optional) sets which part of the picture stays visible inside the frame opening (CSS object-position, default top). Titles are Victoria's (12 Nov 2026); year and story are left empty until she supplies them.
